method: Full text reading divided among root and three source readers. Byte-identical full-file copies checked by SHA256 and covered by the identical content read. All versions with distinct hashes read independently.
completed_before: Substantive design authoring and repository research
coverage_scope: All supplied Project Source text and nested source archives, including distinct old and current versions and the original Investment brief. External repository research has a separate evidence manifest.
portable_normalization: Original source identities, hashes and read receipts retained. Character coordinates were mapped from Python universal-newline text to original UTF-8 byte offsets, including CRLF where present. Original character ranges also retained. Absolute scratch paths replaced by source archive paths.
